title: Japan debates position on nuclear weapons amid Hiroshima and Nagasaki commemorations
subhead: The Japanese government, preparing to revise its defense strategy, is questioning its long-held rejection of nuclear weapons. Rising tensions in East Asia have prompted the defense minister to call for an open discussion on the issue, 'without taboos.'

title: French embassy in Congo faces backlash over visa video
subhead: The newspaper 'Le Canard enchaîné' uncovered a video produced by the French embassy in Brazzaville that many social media users condemned as racist. Published in June and deleted after just a few hours, it focused on the thorny issue of visas.

title: How the French government is convincing banks to loan to Le Pen's campaign
subhead: A consortium of banks should allow far-right candidate Marine Le Pen to obtain a loan in France. In past campaigns, she took loans from Russian and Hungarian establishments after French banks were reluctant to be associated with her.

title: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'
